        return 0.0

    # Extract points
    p1 = points[indices[:, 0]]
    p2 = points[indices[:, 1]]
    p3 = points[indices[:, 2]]
    
    # Calculate areas: 0.5 * | (p2-p1) x (p3-p1) |
    v1 = p2 - p1
    v2 = p3 - p1
